title: FBI-UAP-D018, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-3, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration) of a reported UAP incident, prepared by the FBI at the Department of War's request.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; all facts derive from war.gov metadata, not the image itself.
This is an artist's rendering created in 2026, not a photograph, video, or sensor record of the 2023 event.
The depiction is single-source: it is based on one federal agent's verbal first-hand account (documented in DOW-UAP-D080), not corroborated instrument data.
The rendering is an interpretation and may include artistic detail not present in the original witness description.
The observer and the underlying account are not independently verified within this document.
